title.zh: 英伟达洽谈收购美国AI初创公司Reflection AI
title.en: 英伟达洽谈收购美国AI初创公司Reflection AI

current_state.zh: Nvidia is in early-stage talks to acquire or increase investment in open-weights AI developer Reflection AI, which was valued at $25B in March, with deal forms including an acqui-hire or expanded equity and compute agreements.
